Based on the healthcare Q&A matches provided, it appears that Provider Service Networks (PSNs) may be a more cost-effective option compared to traditional HMOs or primary care case management in Florida's Medicaid program.

A study found that Demonstration PSNs generated slightly greater reductions in expenditures compared to Demonstration HMOs. Additionally, the demonstration program PSN resulted in lower PMPM (Per Million Person-month) expenditures.

In other words, PSNs may help reduce healthcare costs by allowing patients to receive care from providers outside of traditional insurance networks, potentially leading to more efficient use of resources and lower expenditures overall.
